1.text: Nuko nongera kūbura amaso, ngiye kubona mbona umuzingo w'igitabo uguruka.

2.text: Arambaza ati “Ubonye iki?”Ndamusubiza nti “Mbonye umuzingo w'igitabo uguruka, uburebure bwawo ni mikono makumyabiri, n'ubugari bwawo ni mikono cumi.”

3.text: Arambwira ati “Uwo ni umuvumo woherejwe gukwira isi yose, ku ruhande rumwe uhamya yuko uwiba wese azakurwaho, ku rundi uhamya yuko urahira ibinyoma wese azakurwaho.

4.text: Uwo muvumo nzawohereza, ni ko Uwiteka Nyiringabo avuga, winjire mu nzu y'umujura no mu nzu y'urahira izina ryanjye ibinyoma. Uzaba mu mazu yabo imbere, uyatwikane n'ibiti n'amabuye byayo.”

5.text: Maze marayika twavuganaga arasohoka arambwira ati “Noneho ubura amaso urebe kiriya gisohotse uko kimeze.”

6.text: Ndabaza nti “Kiriya ni iki?”Aransubiza ati “Kiriya ni indengo isohotse.” Kandi ati “Mu gihugu cyose uko ni ko basa.”

7.text: Kandi dore umutemeri w'ibati upfunduwe, mbona umugore wicaye imbere mu ndengo.

8.text: Ati “Uyu ni we Bugome.” Maze amujugunya mu ndengo imbere, akubitaho uwo mutemeri w'ibati uremereye ku musozo wayo.

9.text: Nuko nubura amaso ngiye kubona mbona abagore babiri basohotse bafite umuyaga mu mababa yabo, kandi bari bafite amababa nk'ay'igishondabagabo, baterura iyo ndengo bayitwarira mu kirere.

10.text: Mbaza marayika twavuganaga nti “Iriya ndengo barayijyana he?”

11.text: Aransubiza ati “Bagiye kubakira uwo mugore inzu mu gihugu cy'i Shinari, niyuzura azashyirwa ukwe muri icyo gihugu.”
